job_title: Radar Mode Development Engineer/Sensor Fusion Algorithm Developers
job_description:
Radar Mode Development Engineer/Sensor Fusion Algorithm Developer

Location: Fort Worth, TX
Job ID: #71287
Pay Range: $105-140 AN HOUR
12 MONTH CONTRACT
SECRET CLEARANCE REQUIRED!

Looking for a Radar Mode Development Engineer/Sensor Fusion Algorithm Developers with a background in sensor mode and algorithm development to support current development efforts. The successful applicant will be responsible development of new radar modes that enhance aircraft-based sensor fusion capabilities. This position will contribute to software requirements, algorithms, mode design, reviews, and test of operational flight programs respective to radar based sensor fusion algorithms.

Applicant will be a software developer responsible for embedded software definition, design, development and integration to support real-time embedded avionics software projects. The applicant will be responsible for designing, coding, testing and integrating software. Develop, analyze, integrate, and test embedded software for the Fusion team. Contribute to software requirements, design, code, reviews, and test of operational flight programs. Good oral and written communication skills required as is the ability to flex and adapt in a fast-paced team environment.

Basic Qualifications:
-- Required Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field
-- Experience with programming languages such as C, C+, and MATLAB
-- Real Time Operating System (RTOS) experience - (Windows & Linux)
-- Experience with developing sensor modes and algorithms
-- Standard teaming: Ability to work with multi-disciplined teams
-- Experience with full software life cycle development including SW design, architecture, and integration & test
-- Active Secret Clearance

Desired Skills:
-- Knowledge of Agile Software Development
-- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
-- Knowledge of Model Base Systems Engineering (MBSE)
-- Strong knowledge of radar systems specifically pertaining to active electronically scanned arrays (AESA)
-- Strong algorithm development experience that includes radar systems, sensor fusion, tracking algorithms, radar mode development & analysis, and signal processing techniques
-- Previous aircraft tracker development experience including development of Kalman Filtering techniques and processing of sensor measurements is a plus
-- Previous experience designing to software requirements

REQUIRED SKILLS:
10+ years of hands on embedded C++ development.
10+ years of algorithm implementation and verification (Matlab experience desired).
5+ years of Fusion development or Kalman Filter application.
5+ years of Radar development/integration.
5+ years of Visual Studio experience.
5+ years of Windows or Linux experience.

Benefits provided: 401K, medical, dental, and vision, sick time as applicable to state law
